entry_rule: LONG t+1; Upper=max(previous completed Close, previous ExpectedHigh); Open>=Upper; enter only after price falls below Upper-1.0
provenance: Metrics supplied by user from separate full-period backtest; runtime package does not independently reproduce source trade files.
anti_bias: decision uses only frozen LONG t+1, prior completed Close/ExpectedHigh, current Open and live downside reclaim; no T High/Low/Close look-ahead
